question: In an election contested by two parties, Party D secured 12% of the total votes more than Party R. If Party R got 176000 votes, by how many votes did it lose the election?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Party D secured 12% of the total votes more than Party R.

Ratio method

(50 + 6) = (50 - 6)

⇒ 56 : 44

⇒ 14 : 11

⇒ Required = 176000 × 3over11 = 48000

∴ Party R lost the election with 48000 votes.

Given:

Party D secured 12% of the total votes more than Party R.

If Party R got 176000 votes.

**Calculation;**

According to the question

D - 12% = R

⇒ D = R + 12% ––––(1)

Now, D + R = 100% ––––(2)

From equations (1) and (2), we have

⇒ R + 12% + R = 100%

⇒ 2R = 88%

⇒ R = 44%

And D = R + 12% = (44 + 12)% = 56%

If Party R got 176000 votes.

⇒ 44% = 176000

⇒ 1% = 176000over44 = 4000

Party D secured 12% of the total votes more.

⇒ 12 × 4000 = 48000

**∴ Party R lose the election with 48000 votes**
